description: This Java class provides utility methods for working with generic types, specifically for casting objects, checking collections for element types, and verifying map key/value types within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UtilGenerics
classes.description: A utility class offering type-safe casts and checks for Collections and Maps.

methods.name: cast
methods.description: Performs an unchecked cast of an Object to a specified type.

methods.name: checkCollection
methods.description: Validates that the provided object is a Collection with elements of the specified type.

methods.name: checkMap
methods.description: Validates that the provided object is a Map with keys and values of specified types.
